tasks.title: Honor Codex nonterminal retry notifications
tasks.authorization: Research recommendation accepted; product implementation requires owner approval under request 01.
tasks.reason: The installed protocol declares willRetry, but the adapter treats every error notification as terminal. An offline native-retry notice followed by success currently blocks the session.
acceptance: A willRetry=true notification followed by turn completion finishes the same invocation without an application-level replay.
Terminal failure still stops; cancellation and timeout remain effective while native retries are pending.
Preserve usage and failure/retry evidence without incrementing task attempts or awarding competence credit for the retry itself.
Use offline protocol tests; real provider checks remain separate.
